metadata.schedule_summary: Cisplatin on Days 1 and 8; etoposide on Days 1–5. Each cycle lasts 28 days. Two cycles first; two more may be offered after review. Radiotherapy usually starts within 24 hours of the first chemotherapy dose; follow your separate radiation appointment plan.

eligibility: Stage III NSCLC; ECOG 0–1; thoracic radiation plan and suitability confirmed.
exclusions: Hypersensitivity to either medicine/excipients; pregnancy or breastfeeding.
Pre-existing neuropathy grade≥2, pre-existing renal impairment, significant hearing impairment/tinnitus: cisplatin source exclusions.
monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal and liver profile. Audiology and creatinine clearance if clinically indicated.
NCCP FBC Days 1 and 8. Current etoposide SmPC additionally requires a blood count before each etoposide dose, including Days 2–5.
Renal and liver profile before each cycle; extra tests as clinically indicated.

Radiation oncology confirms planning and reviews respiratory, swallowing and skin toxicity. Imaging, tumour-marker testing and follow-up timing are individually prescribed; no universal interval is specified.
dose_modifications: Regimen-specific thresholds and exact gaps are encoded; etoposide count rows do not automatically modify or clear platinum.
Consultant discussion required for any dose modification. Product-information differences are explicit.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Days1/8 Cisplatin high risk; Days2–5 etoposide low risk. Multiday/delayed-emesis plans require a reconciled prescription.

treatment_phases.label: Initial concurrent chemotherapy and thoracic radiotherapy
treatment_phases.duration_text: Two28-day cycles with concurrent radiotherapy; radiation oncology confirms radiation dose, fractions and exact dates.
treatment_phases.schedule_summary: Cisplatin 50 mg/m² on Days 1 and 8; etoposide 50 mg/m² on Days 1–5; repeat every28 days, with concurrent thoracic radiotherapy. Two initial cycles; two more only after review if appropriate.

administration.notes: 1000 mL sodium chloride0.9% over60 minutes. Slow infusion; monitor blood pressure, hypersensitivity and infusion site. Current Fresenius Kabi SmPC says not to use in-line filters.
1000 mL sodium chloride0.9% over1 hour with pre/post hydration and electrolytes per local policy; etoposide infusion may contribute to prehydration on Day 1, but Day 8 has no etoposide infusion.
